description: Table C holds (1,10),(1,20),(1,30),(2,10). For index PK_C (A ASC, B DESC) and then IX_AA (A ASC, B ASC), and for each operator < <= = >= > <>: open a fresh table-type recordset, set Index, Seek op, 1, 20; read NoMatch, A, B; MoveNext and read A, B; MovePrevious twice and read A, B. Asks which row each operator selects on each index direction and the following moves in both directions. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
